description: Add, modify and delete user within IPA server.

parameters.name: displayname
parameters.description: Display name.

parameters.name: gidnumber
parameters.description: Posix Group ID.

parameters.name: givenname
parameters.description: First name. If user does not exist and state=present, the usage of givenname is required.

parameters.name: homedirectory
parameters.description: Default home directory of the user.

parameters.name: ipa_host
parameters.description: IP or hostname of IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_HOST is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_HOST and the value are not specified in the task, then DNS is used to try to discover the FreeIPA server. The relevant entry needed in FreeIPA is the ipa-ca entry. If neither the DNS entry, nor the environment IPA_HOST, nor the value are available in the task, then the default value is used. Default: "ipa.example.com"

parameters.name: ipa_pass
parameters.description: Password of administrative user. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_PASS is used instead. Note that if the urllib_gssapi library is available, it is possible to use GSSAPI to authenticate to FreeIPA. If the environment variable KRB5CCNAME is available, the module uses this Kerberos credentials cache to authenticate to the FreeIPA server. If the environment variable KRB5_CLIENT_KTNAME is available, and KRB5CCNAME is not; the module uses this Kerberos keytab to authenticate. If GSSAPI is not available, the usage of ipa_pass is required.

parameters.name: ipa_port
parameters.description: Port of FreeIPA / IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_PORT is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_PORT and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Default: 443

parameters.name: ipa_prot
parameters.description: Protocol used by IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_PROT is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_PROT and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Choices: "http" "https" ← (default)

parameters.name: ipa_timeout
parameters.description: Specifies idle timeout (in seconds) for the connection. For bulk operations, you may want to increase this in order to avoid timeout from IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_TIMEOUT is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_TIMEOUT and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Default: 10

parameters.name: ipa_user
parameters.description: Administrative account used on IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_USER is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_USER and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Default: "admin"

parameters.name: krbpasswordexpiration
parameters.description: Date at which the user password expires. In the format YYYYMMddHHmmss. For example 20180121182022 expires on 21 January 2018 at 18:20:22.

parameters.name: loginshell
parameters.description: Login shell.

parameters.name: mail
parameters.description: List of mail addresses assigned to the user. If an empty list is passed all assigned email addresses are deleted. If None is passed email addresses are not checked nor changed.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password for a user. It is not set for an existing user unless update_password=always, which is the default.

parameters.name: sn
parameters.description: Surname. If user does not exist and state=present, the usage of sn is required.

parameters.name: sshpubkey
parameters.description: List of public SSH key. If an empty list is passed all assigned public keys are deleted. If None is passed SSH public keys are not checked nor changed.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State to ensure. Choices: "absent" "disabled" "enabled" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: telephonenumber
parameters.description: List of telephone numbers assigned to the user. If an empty list is passed all assigned telephone numbers are deleted. If None is passed telephone numbers are not checked nor changed.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Title.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: Uid of the user.

parameters.name: uidnumber
parameters.description: Account Settings UID/Posix User ID number.

parameters.name: update_password
parameters.description: Set password for a user. Choices: "always" ← (default) "on_create"

parameters.name: userauthtype
parameters.description: The authentication type to use for the user. To remove all authentication types from the user, use an empty list []. The choice idp and passkey has been added in community.general 8.1.0. Choices: "password" "radius" "otp" "pkinit" "hardened" "idp" "passkey"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: This only applies if ipa_prot is https. If set to false, the SSL certificates are not validated. This should only set to false used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Ensure pinky is present and always reset password
  community.general.ipa_user:
    name: pinky
    state: present
    krbpasswordexpiration: 20200119235959
    givenname: Pinky
    sn: Acme
    mail:
      - pinky@acme.com
    telephonenumber:
      - '+555123456'
    sshpubkey:
      - ssh-rsa ....
      - ssh-dsa ....
    uidnumber: '1001'
    gidnumber: '100'
    homedirectory: /home/pinky
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret

- name: Ensure brain is absent
  community.general.ipa_user:
    name: brain
    state: absent
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret

- name: Ensure pinky is present but don't reset password if already exists
  community.general.ipa_user:
    name: pinky
    state: present
    givenname: Pinky
    sn: Acme
    password: zounds
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret
    update_password: on_create

- name: Ensure pinky is present and using one time password and RADIUS authentication
  community.general.ipa_user:
    name: pinky
    state: present
    userauthtype:
      - otp
      - radius
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret

return_values.name: user
return_values.description: User as returned by IPA API. Returned: always
